### T-416 — Add core.label table and extend core.translation

> _2026-10-25 · realm/blong-core · done_

Add core.label with labelId as an ulid primary key, labelKey, languageCode, labelText, editorId and
editedAt, unique on labelKey plus languageCode and indexed on both columns, and register the table
in meta/db with the core group. Extend core.translation with translationId as the primary key,
moving resourceId plus languageCode to a unique constraint, and add editorId and editedAt. Record
what an existing dev database needs for the upgrade intent and keep the schema additive apart from
the key. Files are meta/type/schema.ts and meta/db/db.ts.

core_label added and core_translation rebuilt with translationId; both carry editorId and editedAt.
Evidence: the tap test creates and queries both tables in blong-core-kalin.

### T-417 — Implement label and resource seed merges with ownership

> _2026-10-25 · realm/blong-core · done_

Implement coreLabelMerge and coreTranslationMerge in adapter/db, parsing the YAML block scalars one
pair per line and splitting on the first separator only. Resolve the seed actor through
core.resource.ensure with type core.seed and name core.seed, and replace a row only when editorId is
null or equals that actor, counting the rest as skipped. Skip lines with an empty value. Add tap
tests in server/test covering a seeded row, a user-edited row, an empty value and an unknown
resource name.

core.label.seed and core.translation.seed parse the block scalars, stamp the core.seed actor and
keep hand-edited rows. Evidence: test.translation.flow steps seedLabels, reseedLabels and
editThenReseed pass; the merge predicate was renamed to seed because the generic merge shadows an
early-child realm override (F-598).

### T-418 — Expose translation reads and translatable-resource dropdown
